reviewItem.question: For "Using `cluster.inClusterEnabled: \"false\"`: When `cluster.inClusterEnabled: \"false\"` is explicitly configured, Applications currently configured to sync on the…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: When cluster.inClusterEnabled is set to "false", Applications currently configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state and cannot sync; new Applications cannot use the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete their previously managed resources.
